```cypher
UNWIND ['mod_attendance', 'mod_bigbluebuttonbn', 'mod_customcert'] AS installed_plugin_component
MATCH (p:Plugin {component: installed_plugin_component})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:SUPPORTS]->(mr:MoodleRelease)
WHERE mr.release = '4.0'
WITH p, COLLECT(mr.release) AS supported_releases_4_0
RETURN p.component,
       CASE
           WHEN SIZE(supported_releases_4_0) > 0 THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
       END AS supports_moodle_4_0
LIMIT 100
```
